human_instruction: Implement --from-json support for kajiya-build-line add-issue. The command must preserve the existing explicit argument mode. When --from-json FILE is provided, load issue fields from that JSON file and create the backlog item deterministically. CLI --activate may override or supplement an activate field in the JSON. Return JSON-compatible errors for missing required fields, invalid JSON, missing file, or duplicate issue_id. Do not modify project state except through the existing add_issue behavior.
forbidden_actions: Do not modify docs/state/backlog.json or docs/state/current-project.json during implementation except when explicitly testing add-issue behavior.
Do not close backlog issues automatically.
